category: file host (guest upload, free and paid accounts)

free_tier.stated: Guests upload without registration and files are hosted a maximum of 30 days; the Free account has 10 GB of storage, a 5 GB maximum file and 1 MB/s download speed.

per_object_cap.stated: 5 GB per file on Free; 10 GB Pro; 100 GB Business

retention.stated: 30 days for guest uploads; the Free account lists no expiry on the pricing page

egress.terms: Free download speed is 1 MB/s; Pro and Business list unlimited speeds. Bandwidth is listed as unlimited on every plan.

interface_detail: Web upload; every plan row lists API Access (Put and Get files), marked beta.
tooling: Browser upload and a beta API for put and get on all plans; its documentation was not read.
chaining: Pro at $9.99 per month gives 1 TB of storage and 10 GB files; the free account is the lowest-cost entry with a 1 MB/s read cap.

limits.value: 5 GB per file on Free, 10 GB on Pro, 100 GB on Business
download speed 1 MB/s on Free; unlimited on Pro and Business
10 GB of storage on Free, 1 TB on Pro, 3 TB on Business
guest uploads are hosted a maximum of 30 days

binding_note: At 1 MB/s a 5 GB file takes more than an hour to read back, which binds before the 10 GB storage does.

identity_cost.detail: Guest upload needs no registration; an account needs an email address, to which a confirmation is sent.

reliability_note: No status page was read; free guest files expire after 30 days.
confidence_note: Limits and prices read on the vendor home, pricing and registration pages. Whether guest uploads share the 5 GB cap is as the home page states for free users.
